categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in real estate development, focusing on residential and commercial building development, leasing, and sales. It also has historical involvement in textile manufacturing, including yarn and fabric processing, but this segment has been discontinued since 2018. The core business is now concentrated on property development and construction in the Greater Taipei area.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs conventional real estate development processes including land acquisition, architectural planning, construction outsourcing to qualified contractors (notably its subsidiary, a grade-A construction company), and sales. It integrates green building concepts and smart home technologies into its projects. The company does not conduct in-house R&D for construction technology but focuses on project planning and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual homebuyers and commercial tenants in the Greater Taipei metropolitan area. The company targets mid-priced, multi-functional residential buildings and urban renewal projects, catering to local residents and businesses. The market is domestic, with a focus on urban areas with high demand for housing and commercial spaces.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, specifically in the Greater Taipei area including Taipei City and New Taipei City. Key development projects are located in districts such as Shilin, Daan, and Sanchong. The company does not have overseas operations or listings.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the real estate supply chain, acting as a developer and project manager. It acquires land, commissions construction work to contractors (including its subsidiary construction firm), and manages sales and leasing. It does not engage in upstream raw material production or downstream retail beyond property sales and leasing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on urban renewal and redevelopment projects, emphasizing sustainable development and ESG principles. It aims to expand its project portfolio in prime urban locations, improve financial structure, and enhance operational efficiency. R&D is limited to integrating green building standards and smart technologies into developments rather than technological innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale and leasing of residential and commercial properties. The company also earns income from investment holdings in related subsidiaries and financial assets. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but on project-based sales and rental income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other real estate developers in the Greater Taipei area, where competition is highly localized and project-specific. Its competitive advantages include a strong financial position, extensive experience, a professional management team, and a focus on quality and sustainable development. Market share is influenced by project location and product differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has a capital stock of approximately NT$1.1 billion and total assets around NT$2.5 billion as of the latest fiscal year. Revenue and net profit declined significantly in the most recent year due to a lack of completed projects for sale, but the company maintains a healthy equity ratio (~58%) and strong liquidity. It plans to resume growth by launching new projects in key Taipei districts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes quality construction, sustainable and green building practices, and smart home features to differentiate its properties. It leverages its financial stability and experienced management to ensure project delivery and customer satisfaction. Its focus on urban renewal projects and mid-priced, functional residential buildings aims to meet evolving market demands and regulatory environments.
